title: local cultural values, managerial overconfidence, and sme performance: the mediating role of debt financing
core_idea: Examine relationships among local cultural values (tastura culture), managerial overconfidence, and SME performance, assessing whether debt financing mediates those relationships using survey data from handicraft SME owners and SEM-PLS analysis.
tldr: Investigates whether debt financing mediates the influence of tastura culture and managerial overconfidence on SME performance, using data from 140 handicraft SMEs in Central Lombok and SEM-PLS.
